findings.description: The parser now stores `True` (a bool) as the value for parameters that have no '='. `get_encoding_from_headers` calls `params["charset"].strip(...)` on that value, so it raises AttributeError.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a header like `Content-Type: text/html; charset` (a bare charset token with no '='). The parser sets params['charset']=True, and `True.strip` raises AttributeError. The user sees a crash in `response.encoding` or `text` instead of a fallback to ISO-8859-1.
